mapper.sql: id, title, image_url, link_type, link_target, sort, start_at, end_at, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner (title, image_url, link_type, link_target, sort, start_at, end_at, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkType}, #{linkTarget}, #{sort}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET title = #{title}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, link_type = #{linkType}, link_target = #{linkTarget}, sort = #{sort}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM banner WHERE status = 1 AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at <= #{now}) AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= #{now}) ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
